role: CI gate for docs/REFACTOR_SPEC.md: counts functions and computed properties/inits/closure-initialised properties over 20 body lines or nested deeper than 2, commented-out code lines, empty catches, justified waivers and malformed waivers in Emuqu (and a combined count for the watch app) against .ci budgets.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIR=Emuqu (missing -> 2). LONG/NEST/COMMENT budgets via read_budget in $(...); MEASURED=measure_spec Emuqu (empty -> 2); first line parsed into 9 counts; justified/property budgets read; prints report; over() for each axis (empty catches and malformed waivers against 0); any over -> worst offenders + exit 1; below-budget hints. Watch: budget file missing -> 2, non-integer -> 2; measure_spec on watch dir; total of 4 axes vs .ci/spec_watch_budget.txt (0); over -> exit 1. Else clean.

flags.text: Header says the waiver budgets start at zero and 'The budget is zero'; .ci/spec_justified_long_budget.txt is 7.

For the watch target only the four size/nesting axes are summed; empty catches, commented-out code and malformed waivers in watch files are measured and discarded. If the watch measurement fails, the empty fields evaluate to 0 and the gate passes.

units.does: Prints the whitespace-stripped content of .ci/$1; missing file -> stderr + exit 2. Always called inside $(...), so that exit only ends the subshell and the caller receives an empty budget.

flags.text: read_budget runs inside $(...), so its `exit 2` ends only the subshell. A missing .ci/spec_* budget file gives an empty budget, which over() evaluates as 0. Any axis currently measuring 0 then passes and the script prints 'clean', exit 0, instead of the documented exit-2 config error. Content is not validated as an integer.

units.does: Runs embedded Python over directory $1: for every *.swift, counts commented-out code lines (outside Usage/Example blocks), statement-less catch bodies, malformed swallow-ok markers; finds func/computed-var/init/subscript/closure-initialised declarations, locates the body brace by paren/bracket depth, measures body lines and nesting relative to the body; >20 lines or depth >2 counts as long/deep (func vs prop axis) unless a `// spec:long-function <why>` / `// spec:deep-nesting <why>` waiver sits in the comment block above; bare markers counted malformed. Prints one line of 9 counts, then BADWAIVER/LONG/DEEP rows (top 5 each).

flags.text: find_body_brace does not stop at the end of a body-less protocol requirement unless a ';' or blank line follows, so it takes the next depth-0 `{`. FootPodManager.swift:61 `func stopScanning()` is measured as the body of `extension BLEPeripheralConnecting {` at :64. The jump `i = max(j, i+1)` then skips that extension, so `connect(deviceId:)` is never measured on its own. Docstring says <> depth is tracked; only () and [] are.

units.does: If actual > budget (arithmetic), prints '<label> is X, over budget Y' to stderr and sets global FAILED=1.
